description: A library of reusable single-file HTML slide-deck templates. Each template is one self-contained .html file: no build step, no dependencies, works from file:// and offline.
name: html-presentation-templates

templates.description: Warm paper background, Didone serif display titles with a sturdier Georgia for body headings, gold accents and ornaments. Built for facilitators: labeled activity tags, timed section dividers, a live lesson-timeline footer, offline video embeds, and an on-the-fly font-size control for room readability.
templates.name: Elegant Paper

templates.description: Apple-inspired general presentation template with Liquid Glass: SF type stack, giant tight headlines, Apple blue, pill buttons, frosted refractive glass cards floating over solid color — zero gradients. Solid-black statement and closing slides, agenda, quote, stats, two-column with offline video slot, spec table, and the A−/100%/A+ font control. No lesson timeline: built as a general Canva substitute.
templates.name: Keynote
Atelier

No gradients, no timeline.

templates.name: Washi
templates.description: Japanese-minimalist general presentation template: warm stone background, sumi ink, vermillion hanko seals, ensō circle, vertical accent text, vast whitespace, light-weight sans headlines with Georgia italic quotes, stat band, process, agenda, offline video slot, and the persisted A−/100%/A+ font control. templates.name: Ember
templates.description: Bold creative-brief editorial presentation template: fiery solid vermilion, black ink and warm off-white paper; massive condensed uppercase grotesque headlines (system stacks only), tracked-out kickers, thick black rules, oversized type colliding with image frames, and editorial numbering. Mixes dark statement slides with light content slides. Cover, agenda, big statement, punch list, two-column, stat block, giant quote, CSS/SVG visual interlude, offline video slot, and closing — with the A−/100%/A+ font control. No gradients, no lesson timeline: built as a general Canva substitute.

templates.name: Monument
templates.description: Stark black-and-gray minimalist presentation template in a Swiss/brutalist voice: pure black canvas, warm gray and off-white type, giant neutral-grotesque headlines at extreme scale, rigid grid, hairline rules, numbered sections 01–10, and vast negative space — the typography is the design. One inverted light slide for rhythm. Cover, agenda, big statement, text with bullets, two columns, stat band, quote, SVG visual interlude, offline video slot, and closing — with the A−/100%/A+ font control. No gradients, no lesson timeline: built as a general Canva substitute.
